slug: 2026-03-31 Africa we have a data problem

systems.system: EBDRS (electronic birth and death registration system)
systems.tiers: Health offices: about 4,571 digitised since 2017, rural ones over GPRS/3G; civil registry offices are described as paper only, without computers or internet
Launched nationally in 2026, with pilots in selected primary health facilities
National education dashboards; no school-level digital collection evidenced
Complaint registration and police record issuance at stations

note: Egypt's rows cover clinics, schools, police stations and civil registry offices, all ministry field offices (class central); nothing is stated about local government offices. The source is also on the study's exclude list.
